comparison.objective: Move a spring clothes peg from a basket rim and clip a hanging photo corner to a wire; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Squeeze and maintain a spring clip open, align thin wire and paper between its jaws, then release without dislodging the photo.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a second peg closed on both wire and photo, released and still for two seconds; candidate requires retained gripper opening through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Spring-clip transport and thin-object alignment do not test coupled threaded setting preservation.
